title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Esther 3: Haman is promoted, Mordecai will not bow, and a decree goes out to destroy the Jews.

questions.text: How is Haman the son of Hammedatha described when the king promoted him?
questions.explanation: King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite and set his seat above all the princes.

questions.text: What did Mordecai refuse to do?
questions.explanation: All the king's servants in the gate bowed down to Haman, but Mordecai didn't bow down or pay him homage.

answers.text: Bow down and pay homage to Haman

questions.text: What had Mordecai told the king's servants about himself?
questions.explanation: The servants told Haman, for Mordecai had told them that he was a Jew.

answers.text: That he was a prince of Persia

questions.text: Instead of laying hands on Mordecai alone, what did Haman seek to do?
questions.explanation: Haman scorned laying hands on Mordecai alone, so he sought to destroy all the Jews throughout the kingdom, Mordecai's people.

answers.text: Have Mordecai sent out of Susa
Destroy all the Jews, Mordecai's people

questions.text: What is Pur, according to the text?
questions.explanation: They cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day and month to month.

questions.text: In which month did they begin to cast Pur before Haman?
questions.explanation: In the first month, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur before Haman.

questions.text: How much did Haman offer to pay into the king's treasuries?
questions.explanation: Haman offered to pay ten thousand talents of silver into the king's treasuries.

questions.text: What did the king take from his hand and give to Haman?
questions.explanation: The king took his ring from his hand and gave it to Haman, the Jews' enemy.

questions.text: On which day were the Jews to be destroyed according to the letters?
questions.explanation: The letters ordered all Jews to be destroyed in one day, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month Adar.

answers.text: The thirteenth day of the month Adar
The thirteenth day of the first month
The first day of the month Nisan
The tenth day of the month Tebeth

questions.text: How did the city of Susa react when the decree was given out?
questions.explanation: The king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was perplexed.

answers.text: It sent gifts to the king
